t: This is Albion Road, a street in the London Borough of Hackney. There isn't much recorded about the road itself, but two people are tied to it. Edward John Arnett, who went on to work as a British colonial official in Africa, was born here in 1876. And Edward Bret Ince, a nineteenth-century publisher, died here in 1886. So this ordinary Hackney street marks both a beginning and an ending for two very different lives.
